_doc: Ranked prebuild targets for `hctf prebuild --lane warmups`: classical codec families NOT yet in lib/warmups_codecs.CANDIDATES (D1-D13 walked base64, rot13, hex, binary, decimal, octal, %XX, html entities, \\u escapes, base32, base64url, reverse, Atbash -- the prompt is always a pun on the codec). Each worker adds a speculative encoder+decoder + fixtures from an independent implementation; DAYS entries are GM-confirmed and never edited.

targets.goal: Baconian cipher (A/B 5-bit groups, also as case/font-style or 0/1 groups); prompt puns: 'bacon','Francis'
Polybius square digit pairs (5x5, I/J merged), plus tap code (dots/knocks); prompts: 'square','knock','prison'
uuencode / xxencode bodies (begin 644 lines or bare)
Unicode Braille patterns U+2800 (Grade 1 letters, digits via number sign)
phone keypad: multi-tap digit runs (44 33 555) and T9 digit words; prompts 'phone','dial','keypad'
1337 substitution (4->a 3->e 1->l/i 0->o 5->s 7->t) as a keyless free-text transform
columnar / scytale transposition with small keys (2-8 columns, key = title word)
fullwidth / mathematical-alphanumeric / small-caps Unicode letter variants mapped back to ASCII
zero-width characters (U+200B/C/D, U+FEFF) carrying bits between visible text
Vigenere / Beaufort / autokey where the key is a word from the challenge title/prompt (pun) -- extend key extraction
Pig Latin and word-level games (reverse each word, swap halves) as keyless free-text transforms
